messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: streaming.sse p99 latency spike detected in us-east-1 — metric spike > 5s; paging oncall.

tara_oncall: I’m on it. getting context now — which customers showing errors?

alerts-bot: Top affected routes: /v1/chat/stream (60% of spikes), /v1/generate/stream (25%). Error rate small increase (0.6%). Streaming stall ratio up from 0.5% -> 4.8%.

sam_eng: seeing repeated proxy timeouts from edge-proxy-12 in us-east-1 (504 during long tails). stack traces show keepalive-reset on write. past hour tail distribution: p95=1.4s, p99=3.8s -> current p99=6.2s.

lee_sre: can you paste the connection logs? also any client-side backpressure signals?

sam_eng: paste logs: ```[2026-03-17T16:42:11Z] proxy=edge-proxy-12 conn=0x7f client=10.2.3.45 write_err=EPIPE flush=1200ms kv_cache_hit=false``` multiple entries with flush > 1s. Looks like internal queueing then write failure.

tara_oncall: tagging @olivia_pm — any active customers currently running high-throughput streams? need customer-impact triage.

olivia_pm: Customer X and Customer Z reported intermittent stalls ~16:30 UTC; support tickets inbound but no broad outage. They're on the hosted API with long-chat workloads. Estimated sessions impacted ~0.4% of total.

sam_eng: hypothesis: sudden burst of long-sequence sessions causing continuous batching queues to grow on runtime, proxy writes saturate socket buffers -> backpressure. Also observed a recent canary deploy to edge-proxy-12 ~16:20 that changed NGINX keepalive settings.

lee_sre: roll forward mitigation: revert config on edge-proxy-12 to prior keepalive/timeout values and drain new connections; scale proxy pool by +2 instances in us-east-1. I’ll run the rollback now.

tara_oncall: good. I’ll notify customers in support thread to set expectations; put incident page and live mitigation notes.

sam_eng: guidance for devs: if you see SSE clients with stalled chunks, increase client-side socket read timeout to avoid tight retry loops. Also enabling prefix KV caching reduces long-tail generation for repeated prompts.

lee_sre: rollback initiated at 16:48 UTC. monitoring shows p99 dropping to 4.1s after config change. scaling proxies underway (+2 ready).

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation action applied (proxy config rollback + scale). p95 now 1.2s, p99 2.9s. Continue watch for 30m.

olivia_pm: communicating to affected customers: short-term impact, mitigation applied, follow-up postmortem promised.

tara_oncall: handing off to sam_eng and lee_sre for postmortem and root-cause. I’ll demobilize oncall in 30m unless we see regression. :white_check_mark: 

sam_eng: filing thunder ticket with deploy diff and kernel stats; will include request logs and batching histograms.

lee_sre: note for postmortem: add alert on sudden proxy config changes and a runbook step to validate keepalive/socket settings before rollouts.

incident-bot: RESOLVE: monitoring indicates SLO trending back to normal. If any regressions re-open this thread. :thumbsup:
